description: Vdatum is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS); NOAA Office of Coast Survey. VDatum stands for Vertical Datum Transformation, an evolving software tool under development by NOAA's National Ocean Service. VDatum's primary purpose is to convert elevation data from various sources into a common reference system. A common reference system is important because irregularities can occur when maps and charts are created from different data sources. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
